notes_for_editor: Thin record. Both sources are the Forest Fire Lookout Association inventory, which gives county, coordinates, type and status only. The record's name, kind, status and coordinates match the inventory; no correction. Two web searches turned up a search summary attributed to firelookout.org that gives a Granite Peak on the Gila National Forest at 8,731 ft, built 1930, Aermotor LX-24, status Former. That page was not opened and is not in the crawl cache, so the story leaves it out. If an editor can open it and confirm, it could supply the build date and design. Other searches returned Granite Peak lookouts in other states; they were not used.
